Package com.composum.platform.commons.credentials

Interface CredentialService

  • All Known Implementing Classes:
    CredentialServiceImpl
    public interface CredentialService
    A systemwide credential store where you can retrieve credentials which are stored encrypted in the repository. Each creadential pair has a systemwide unique ID, and might have a path configured, to which the user has to have access, and/or a group, to which the user must belong.

    • Method Detail

      • initHttpContextCredentials

        void initHttpContextCredentials​(@NotNull
                                @NotNull org.apache.http.client.protocol.HttpClientContext context,
                                @NotNull
                                @NotNull org.apache.http.auth.AuthScope authScope,
                                @NotNull
                                @NotNull String credentialIdOrToken,
                                @Nullable
                                @Nullable org.apache.sling.api.resource.ResourceResolver aclCheckResolver)
                         throws javax.jcr.RepositoryException,
                                IllegalArgumentException,
                                IllegalStateException
        Initializes credentials for use with an HttpClient for the given {authScope}.
        Parameters:
        context - the HTTP client context to initialize
        authScope - authentication scope
        credentialIdOrToken - ID for the credentials, usually a path from the credential root, e.g. /content/ist/testsites/testpages/localfullsite. It can also start with a slash, but it is not recommended to do so, since that could be confused with an absolute path. It is also possible to give a token returned by getAccessToken(String, ResourceResolver, String).
        aclCheckResolver - a resolver that has to be able to resolve the aclpath stored in the credential as a security mechanism.
        Throws:
        javax.jcr.RepositoryException - error accessing the repository or the aclpath could not be read with the aclCheckResolver
        IllegalArgumentException - if the credentials do not exist or are of the wrong type
        IllegalStateException - if the service is not enabled

      • sendMail

        String sendMail​(@NotNull
                @NotNull javax.mail.internet.MimeMessage message,
                @NotNull
                @NotNull String credentialIdOrToken,
                @Nullable
                @Nullable org.apache.sling.api.resource.ResourceResolver aclCheckResolver)
         throws javax.jcr.RepositoryException,
                IOException,
                javax.mail.MessagingException
        Sends an email using the credentials specified by {credentialIdOrToken}.
        Parameters:
        message - the message to send. It is cloned by MimeMessage.writeTo(OutputStream) to avoid exposing the credentials, so it's unmodified.
        credentialIdOrToken - ID for the credentials, usually a path from the credential root, e.g. content/ist/testsites/testpages/localfullsite. It can also start with a slash, but it is not recommended to do so, since that could be confused with an absolute path. It is also possible to give a token returned by getAccessToken(String, ResourceResolver, String).
        aclCheckResolver - a resolver that has to be able to resolve the aclpath stored in the credential as a security mechanism.
        Returns:
        the Message-ID of the sent message.
        Throws:
        javax.jcr.RepositoryException - error accessing the repository or the aclpath could not be read with the aclCheckResolver
        IllegalArgumentException - if the credentials do not exist or are of the wrong type
        IllegalStateException - if the service is not enabled
        IOException
        javax.mail.MessagingException

      • getAccessToken

        String getAccessToken​(@NotNull
                      @NotNull String credentialId,
                      @Nullable
                      @Nullable org.apache.sling.api.resource.ResourceResolver aclCheckResolver,
                      @NotNull
                      @NotNull String type)
               throws javax.jcr.RepositoryException,
                      IllegalArgumentException,
                      IllegalStateException
        Returns a token that can be used in place of a credentialId to access a credential for some time. This is sometimes neccessary if a service needs credentials for retries - it won't have access to the users resolver for the acl checks.
        Parameters:
        aclCheckResolver - a resolver that has to be able to resolve the aclpath stored in the credential as a security mechanism.
        Throws:
        javax.jcr.RepositoryException - error accessing the repository or the aclpath could not be read with the aclCheckResolver
        IllegalArgumentException - if the credentials do not exist or are of the wrong type
        IllegalStateException - if the service is not enabled
